verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־ הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃ וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê- hā·’îš ’ă·šer lō hā·laḵ ba·‘ă·ṣaṯ rə·šā·‘îm lō ‘ā·māḏ ū·ḇə·ḏe·reḵ ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm lō yā·šāḇ ū·ḇə·mō·wō·šaḇ lê·ṣîm
verses.literal: Blessed [is] the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked or set foot on the path of sinners or sit in the seat of mockers

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im ḥep̄·ṣōw bə·ṯō·w·raṯ Yah·weh ū·ḇə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯōw yeh·geh yō·w·mām wā·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: But . . . his delight [is] in the Law of the LORD and on His law he meditates day and night

verses.original: וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־ פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִתֵּ֬ן פִּרְי֨וֹ׀ בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־ יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל יַצְלִֽיחַ׃ אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·‘êṣ šā·ṯūl ‘al- pal·ḡê mā·yim ’ă·šer yit·tên pir·yōw bə·‘it·tōw wə·‘ā·lê·hū lō- yib·bō·wl wə·ḵōl yaṣ·lî·aḥ ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: He is like a tree planted by streams of water vvv yielding its fruit in season whose leaf does not wither and who prospers - in all he does

verses.original: לֹא־ כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־ כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ḵên hā·rə·šā·‘îm kî ’im- kam·mōṣ ’ăšer- tid·də·p̄en·nū rū·aḥ
verses.literal: Not so the wicked For [they are] like chaff - driven off by the wind

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ רְ֭שָׁעִים לֹא־ יָקֻ֣מוּ בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên rə·šā·‘îm lō- yā·qu·mū bam·miš·pāṭ wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm ba·‘ă·ḏaṯ ṣad·dî·qîm
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the wicked {will} not stand in the judgment nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יוֹדֵ֣עַ דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh yō·w·ḏê·a‘ de·reḵ ṣad·dî·qîm wə·ḏe·reḵ rə·šā·‘îm tō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous but the way of the wicked will perish
